{{Top|leg}}
'''Subsonic grenades''' were a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] that utilized sound waves rather than explosives to inflict damage. As the name suggests, it utilizes sound waves in the sub-sonic range to physically knock over an adversary, causing limited physical damage.
